verdict.rationale: Insomnia ships an official CLI, Inso CLI, documented at its own docs section. It runs API tests from Git workflows and lints OpenAPI specs in CI (`inso lint spec`). It is built for non-interactive use: prompts are disabled and exit codes pass or fail the run, which suits agent-driven automation. Missing for 10: evidence of AI- or agent-specific affordances (e.g. machine-readable output or agent-oriented docs), documented coverage beyond testing and linting, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
